description: Use when you need company research, due diligence or a quick analysis of a business from its website domain and optional ticker. Do not use for private financials, credit scores, people search or businesses without a website. Returns JSON with a company research dossier in one call: domain registration and DNS, email and website security, latest news and, with a ticker, SEC financials, priced below the separate calls for 0.03 USDC per call. Typical response time 8000 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.03 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

name.description: Company name for the news search (taken from the domain when omitted), e.g. Stripe

ticker.description: Stock ticker for SEC financials, US filers only (no financials when omitted), e.g. AAPL
